title: Villa Grandeur | KEY.co
description_expanded: This home is beautiful throughout and easily accommodated 18 adults and 3 children. The elevator was especially nice for my 92 year old mother to get between the 3 floors. Beds were all very comfortable and there was plenty of eating space on the main kitchen floor. Multiple dishwashers, refrigerators and freezers on the main floor made storing food and drinks very easy. The golf cart and bikes available at the house were very handy to have. Shops and dining were accessible within a half mile. The pool was so nice to have out the back door on the lower level. Access to the beach was easy from the walkway. The views from all levels of the home were spectacular. We are very much considering a return visit next summer. You will be very happy renting this property for the amenities and location on the beach. Designed for both relaxation and entertainment, the home features a stunning resort-style outdoor oasis with a heated pool, spa, cascading water features, and a spacious beachfront lounge deck. Inside, a chef-inspired kitchen anchors the open-concept living space, complemented by elegant gathering areas, a game room, wet bar, and panoramic Gulf-view balconies. With private beach access, effortless elevator access between levels, and thoughtfully designed spaces for large groups, this remarkable beachfront retreat captures the essence of refined 30A living.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
